name: Miboujin Gangu ~Boku no Oba wa Nikuyoku Dorei~
original_name: 未亡人玩具～僕の叔母は肉欲奴隷～
source:
The main character starts boarding at his aunt's house. Her name is Kotomi and she lost her husband two years ago. There is another girl boarding at her house, Kureha, his cousin. One day, he sees Kotomi masturbating at her room. She asks him to lie by her side for a while to soften her sadness and he accepts it. He is supposed to lie by her side at first, but they finally sleep together.... Kureha soon notices their relationship and says to him, "If you don't sleep with me now, I'll kill myself...." Kureha's hatred doesn't settle down and it goes against Kotomi....

translation:
主角开始寄宿在他姨妈家。她的名字叫Kotomi，两年前失去了丈夫。她家寄宿着另一个女孩，红羽，他的表弟。有一天，他看到琴美在她的房间里自慰。她请求他在她身边躺一会儿以减轻她的悲伤，他接受了。一开始他应该躺在她身边，但他们最终睡在一起了……红羽很快注意到了他们的关系，并对他说：“如果你现在不和我一起睡，我就会自杀……”红羽的仇恨并没有平息，而是与琴美作对……
